howItWorks.heading: Bookings on autopilot in three steps

steps.title: Share your booking link
steps.body: Add your Certxa booking link to your Google Business Profile, Instagram bio, Facebook page, or anywhere clients find you.

steps.title: Clients pick their slot
steps.body: Clients choose their service, provider, and time — all from their phone. No calls, no back-and-forth.

steps.title: You get notified instantly
steps.body: Certxa confirms the booking, sends the client a reminder, and updates your calendar in real time.

items.title: Google & Instagram booking
items.body: Clients book directly from your Google Business Profile or Instagram profile — no app download required.

items.title: Automated reminders
items.body: SMS and email reminders go out automatically before each appointment, so fewer clients forget their appointment.

items.title: Real-time availability
items.body: Your calendar updates instantly as bookings come in — no double-bookings, no manual updates.

items.title: Multi-provider scheduling
items.body: Clients choose their preferred provider. Each staff member gets their own calendar and availability settings.

items.title: Waitlist management
items.body: When a slot opens up, Certxa automatically notifies the next client on the waitlist — filling gaps without any effort from you.

integrations.heading: Book from Google, Instagram, and more
integrations.body: Certxa connects your booking calendar to the platforms your clients already use. One link, everywhere.

items.question: Do clients need to download an app to book?
items.answer: No. Certxa's booking page works in any mobile browser. Clients tap your link and book in under a minute — no app, no account required.

items.question: Can I require a deposit or card on file?
items.answer: Not yet. Deposits and prepayments at booking are still in development. Today, Certxa protects your time with automated text and email reminders before every appointment.

items.question: How do automated reminders work?
items.answer: Certxa sends SMS and email reminders at intervals you configure — for example, 48 hours and 2 hours before the appointment. Clients can confirm or cancel directly from the reminder.

items.question: Can clients book with a specific provider?
items.answer: Yes. Each staff member has their own calendar and availability. Clients can choose their preferred provider or let Certxa assign the next available one.

items.question: What happens when a slot opens up?
items.answer: Certxa automatically notifies the next client on the waitlist by SMS or email. They can claim the slot with one tap — no manual follow-up needed.
